purpose: Generate review candidates for entity facets from existing repository sources. Mining never changes canon automatically.

inputs.rule: Search only around known entity aliases; do not invent entities from capitalized phrases alone.

promotion_rules: Structured source fields retain their source mode in candidate provenance.
A candidate from one literary scene defaults to established_scene or unresolved, never canonical.
Creative enhancements for real people remain creative candidates and cannot become ordinary capabilities.
Species-trait candidates require at least two independent supporting source refs or explicit collective wording before promotion.
If two source stores disagree, emit a conflict candidate rather than choosing one.
Candidate aliases are normalized for whitespace/case but original spelling is preserved.
